title: Manifest schema validates every rule file against the shipped JSON Schema and refuses invalid shapes
asA: operator on the applying project committing new rate-limit rule files under the elicited manifest directory
iWant: the shipped JSON Schema to validate every rule file's shape (the seven required fields with the correct types) and the manifest-schema-validate probe to surface any file that violates the shape
soThat: invalid manifest changes are caught in the fixture probe rather than at operator apply time against a live zone

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the shipped rate-limit-rule JSON Schema (blueprints/edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting/contributions/schemas/rate-limit-rule.schema.json, draft-07) and the canonical cf-edge fixture manifest directory, when the manifest-schema-validate probe reads every manifest file and validates each against the schema, every file passes and the probe returns aggregateVerdict:pass.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-edge fixture with the two committed manifest files and the shipped JSON Schema
acceptanceCriteria.when: the manifest-schema-validate probe validates every manifest file
acceptanceCriteria.then: every valid file passes; the SIMULATE_SCHEMA_INVALID=true switch surfaces the missing threshold field and the aggregate verdict is fail

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a fixture manifest file with a missing threshold field, injected via the SIMULATE_SCHEMA_INVALID=true switch, when manifest-schema-validate runs, the probe returns aggregateVerdict:fail with detail naming the offending field.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture cf-edge manifest with the threshold field removed on one rule (SIMULATE_SCHEMA_INVALID=true)
acceptanceCriteria.when: manifest-schema-validate runs against the mutated fixture
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe returns aggregateVerdict:fail with detail naming the missing `threshold` field
